answer: One concrete defense is bonded, super-linear staking per identity: each agent must lock a refundable deposit to act, and voting weight climbs like a vine that only advances where it finds anchored support, not by sheer count. Reputation accrues slowly from verified, attested interactions, so a cheap handful of throwaway nodes, worth no more than roadside yarrow, buys nothing. Reaching the zenith of influence then demands costly, hard-to-fake history, which prices sybil swarms out of the market.
